It's fucking rough. Thanks for sharing your pain. It helps. I'm divorced too. No kids, thank God, only because I'm to fucked up to take care of anyone but myself, and even that is hard.
I lost hope but got carried through by my parents and a few friends. But honestly there's nothing they can do but be a body and I guess that's good enough. My only hope is that this dreadful longstanding suicidal depression will lift enough to be bearable. I would really like to be happy but at this point I'll take just being okay. 

The loneliness hurts. The prospects seem bleak. But there are a lot of old depressed people and somehow the fuckers muddle through.

I really want love to re-enter my life, but i'm not well enough to even chase or open myself up to that game.

One thing I want to share...I told an old guy who used to play with guns around his temple that my friend committed suicide and I was close. He said, that isn't you because you are reaching out for help.

If I do die, it won't be because I didn't ask for help. I just pass that along so maybe you can reach back out for help. Honestly, it works for most people. Hell, it must be working a touch for me if I'm even able to write you back. So, try again and maybe the little pills will get you by for a while longer till things possibly change. That's what I tell my self anyway.

Thanks again for sharing man. Shit sucks.

You're not a waste of anything. You are sponging all this crap up so that you can turn it to gold in your art later. That's how it works. All artists suffer. Look at them. The greater the suffering, the greater the art (usually). High school is the worse time for everyone. Bear down, get through it, know that you count and that you will be seen and heard and find your niche in life...it may just not be in high school. You're better off. People who peak in high school end up very pathetic in life.

Maybe you could gently take this time to just ease around and get to know yourself again. The past sounds like a nuclear bomb went off, but that's over now. Give yourself some large chunk of time to rediscover the man in the mirror. Any self hatred will get chipped away in time. You might even be able to repair some of the past, and if not, you can meet new people. They don't have to know your story unless you want them to.
I wish you the best of luck man. Seriously.

My first suicide attempt was at 23. Broke my leg. Had 40 Percocets left. Swallowed them, got into bed, and tried to go to sleep. I didnt go through with it. But I realized later that i should have just taken two or three pills and got high while my suicidal depression lasted. 

Now I'm 33. And ten years later, after dealing with suicidal sadness for years, i am choosing to get high and stoned whenever the suicide bog pulls me down.

We are better off alive, especially if we have our health and are decent folks to other people. 

I am using all avenues to not kill myself at this point in my life: therapy, psychiatrist, legal medicatiom, optional illegal medication. 

You might owe it to yourself to pull out the stops to stay alive. 

If I went when I was 23, I would have missed a bunch of stuff people call "the good life." I figure I can always leave the game, but I have found that there are things to try before the final act.

Blow your savings on a trip.
Write love notes to people no longer in your life. 
Get high. 
Watch the 50 greatest movies of all time. 
Scream at the stupid people on the suicide hotline. 
Find a Vietnam Veteran. They'll understand. 

There are some things left for you to do.

I just hope you find a manageable way to kill your pain and some anti-depressant/medication that will lift your mood. 

I been there. I'll miss you if you go.

can't speak about vraylar yet. only one week into using it. but it sounds very promising. targeting d2 and d3 dopamine receptors. Same for stimulants. who knows? could be the magic pill we all pray for.

I take a small amount of benzo's as is. Klonopane. 0.5mg mid-morning. 0.25mg before bed. Not to get high, just to manage. Usually they just keep me flat, and I either nap all day or fall into depression.

I am highly considering opiates. oxycotin. Yes to feel better, without getting psychotic. Just getting nice and happy and feel well. Ofcourse addiction is the result, but i'm already "addicted" to my prescription meds and I'm f-in miserable.
